newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean won ends higher on firmer yen vs dlr.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean won ends higher on firmer yen vs dlr.

text.p: The won finished stronger versus the dollar on Thursday underpinned by a rise in the Japanese yen against the U.S. currency on the world markets and corporate dollar selling ahead of the Korean Thanksgiving holiday, dealers said.
They said stop-loss dollar selling from foreign banks and export negotiations helped to strengthen the domestic unit.

"Everybody was selling dollars," said a trader at Korea First Bank. "We couldn't figure out where the support for the dollar was. It kept going lower." The won closed at 823.90 after opening at 827.50, the intraday low. It peaked at 823.20.
